# Machine Learning Certification Hub

> Open-source study hub created by Michaël Bettan for mastering AI/ML engineering and acing Google Cloud and Anthropic Claude certifications. Provides interactive HTML study guides, architecture diagrams, comparison tables, and self-assessment drills.

## Overview

- **Site URL**: https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/
- **Author**: Michaël Bettan (https://www.linkedin.com/in/mbettan/ · https://github.com/mbettan)
- **License**: Apache-2.0 (https://github.com/mbettan/machine-learning-cert/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Interactive Study Guides (HTML)

- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/RAG.html): Context strategies (RAG vs. Long Context vs. Fine-Tuning vs. Prompt Caching vs. Live Tools), chunking, dense/sparse/hybrid retrieval (`BM25` + `HNSW`/`ScaNN`), Reciprocal Rank Fusion (`RRF`), cross-encoder reranking, untrusted context & refusal gates, Agentic RAG & memory, GraphRAG, Google Cloud RAG (Vertex AI Search, Vector Search, AlloyDB/pgvector), federated vs. ingested architectures, ACL security, semantic caching, and RAG triad evaluation (`RAGAS`).
- [Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ADK.html): Open-source code-first framework for enterprise AI agents — `LlmAgent`, `Runner`, `SessionService`, deterministic workflow agents (`SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `LoopAgent`), ADK 2.0 graph `Workflow` (`JoinNode`, `Event(route=...)`), multi-agent delegation (`sub_agents`, `AgentTool`, `RemoteA2aAgent`), scoped state & `VertexAiMemoryBankService`, `FunctionTool` & `output_schema`, `McpToolset` & A2A, progressive-disclosure `SkillToolset`, callback/plugin guardrails, HITL resilience (`ReflectAndRetryToolPlugin`), sandboxing (`GkeCodeExecutor`, Agent Identity), trajectory evaluation (`adk eval`, `adk conformance test`), and Agent Runtime / Cloud Run / GKE deployment.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/MCP.html): Open JSON-RPC 2.0 standard connecting AI hosts/clients to external MCP servers via `Resources`, `Prompts`, `Tools`, `Sampling`, and `Roots` over `stdio` and Streamable HTTP/SSE transports.
- [Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/A2A.html): Open multi-agent interoperability standard (Linux Foundation) covering `.well-known/agent-card.json` Agent Cards, capability discovery, Task lifecycle states, Artifacts, streaming (`SendStreamingMessage`), and push notifications.
- [Machine Learning 101 (ML101)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ML101.html): Supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, regression vs. classification, loss functions (`MSE`, `MAE`, cross-entropy), gradient descent, overfitting/regularization (`L1`/`L2`, dropout), confusion matrix metrics (`Precision`, `Recall`, `F1`, `ROC-AUC`), and deep neural networks (`CNN`, `RNN`, `Transformer`).
- [Generative AI 101 (GenAI101)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/GenAI101.html): Foundation model lifecycle, tokenization, self-attention, decoding parameters (`temperature`, `top-k`, `top-p`), adaptation spectrum (prompting, RAG, PEFT/LoRA, RLHF/DPO), hallucination mitigation, and AI safety/governance.
- [Prompt Engineering](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/PromptEngineering.html): Zero-shot/few-shot prompting, Chain-of-Thought (`CoT`), Self-Consistency, Tree-of-Thoughts (`ToT`), `ReAct`, system prompt architecture, structured JSON outputs, and prompt injection defenses.
- [Google Foundational Models](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/Google.html): Gemini model family (Ultra, Pro, Flash, Nano), multimodal reasoning, Imagen, Chirp, Veo, Codey, Med-PaLM/AlphaFold specialized models, Vertex AI platform, and safety filters.
- [Anthropic Foundational Models](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/Anthropic.html): Claude model family (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku), Constitutional AI (`RLAIF`), harmlessness/helpfulness/honesty (`HHH`), extended thinking, tool use, computer use, and prompt caching.
- [Claude Platform & API](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ClaudeAPI.html): Building on the Claude API — Messages API request shape, system-prompt altitude, the tool-use loop (`tool_use` / `tool_result`, `tool_use_id`, `is_error`, `tool_choice`), agent scaling & programmatic tool calling (`CodeMode` in V8 isolates), `stop_reason` handling (including `refusal`, `max_tokens`, `model_context_window_exceeded`), streaming events, structured outputs, adaptive thinking with `effort`, 4 context strategies (`Write / Select / Compress / Isolate`), context rot taxonomy (`poisoning / confusion / clash`), multi-agent context contracts, compaction and prompt caching, Message Batches, retriable vs. terminal errors, evals and cost levers, deployment platforms (Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry), data residency, model-ID pinning, and security for API apps.
- [Claude Code & Agent SDK](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ClaudeCode.html): Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK — execution surfaces (worktrees, cloud web/mobile, `/teleport`), Deep Agent 4-pillar architecture, permission modes and allow/ask/deny rules, settings and `CLAUDE.md` memory precedence, context rot & `/clear` vs `/compact`, `/output-style` & `/statusline`, Spec-Driven Development (`SPEC.md` + `TodoWrite`), hooks (`PreToolUse`, exit-code semantics), subagents & wave scaling, skills (`SKILL.md`, 3-level progressive disclosure), plugins and marketplaces, MCP configuration (`.mcp.json` scopes, env expansion), headless CI (`claude -p --bare`, `/install-github-app`, `/rewind` checkpointing), team rollout with managed settings, Agent SDK `settingSources`, and Managed Agents.
- [Vibe Coding & Swarm Prototyping](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/vibecoding.html): Conversational AI-assisted software development (Vibe Coding) vs. parallel multi-agent exploration (Swarm Prototyping), risk profiles, verification gates, and production handoff.
- [Instruction-Driven Development (IDD / SDD)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/idd.html): Specification-Driven Development workflow where living markdown specs (`SPEC.md`), architecture rules, and automated acceptance verification drive deterministic AI code generation.

## Interactive Practice Quizzes

- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=rag): 22 scenario-based multiple-choice questions with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [Agent Development Kit (ADK) Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=adk): 25 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 16 ADK sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [Claude Platform & API Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=claude-api): 32 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 14 Claude API sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.
- [Claude Code & Agent SDK Practice Quiz](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/quiz.html?topic=claude-code): 32 scenario-based multiple-choice questions covering all 13 Claude Code sections with instant distractor diagnostics and study guide deep links.

# Curriculum Syllabus & Section Outline (By Study Guide)

## [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/RAG.html)
- **Canonical URL**: https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/RAG.html
- **Summary**: Master Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): hybrid search, RRF, cross-encoder reranking, Agentic RAG, GraphRAG, ACL security, and Vertex AI patterns.
- **Core Sections**:
  - Overview & Core Mechanics
  - When to Use RAG (vs. Fine-Tuning, Long Context & Live Tools)
  - Architecture: Offline Indexing & Online Answering
  - Indexing: Parsing, Chunking & Enrichment
  - Embeddings & Vector Search
  - Retrieval: Hybrid Search, RRF & Reranking
  - Generation: Untrusted Context, Refusal Behavior & Groundedness
  - Agentic RAG & Three-Layer Agent Memory
  - GraphRAG, Structured & Multimodal Data
  - RAG on Google Cloud
  - Federated Retrieval vs. Ingested RAG
  - Security, Access Control & Fairness
  - Freshness, Index Updates & Migration
  - Semantic Caching & Latency Budget
  - Evaluation, Grading Hierarchy & Rollback Gates
  - Failure Modes & Exam Traps
  - Multimedia & Deep Dive Resources
- **Key Topics & Subsections**: Definition · Why It Exists (Standalone LLM Limits) · Three Core Phases · Why Long Context Alone Fails at Scale · Four Context Strategies & the Working-Memory Cliff · The Working-Memory Cliff · Three-Part Executive Tradeoff Framing · RAG Paradigms (Naive, Advanced & Modular) · Parsing Comes First · Contextual Header (Before vs. After) · Enrichment Mechanics · The Semantic Recall Role · Knobs, Quantization & Scale-Out · Vector Store Landscape · Hybrid Search Decision Rule · Query Transformation (Pre-Retrieval) · Metadata Filtering (Pre-Filter vs. Post-Filter) · Untrusted Input Isolation & Fail-Closed Screening · Context Ordering & Prompt-Cache Prefix · Agentic RAG: Retrieval Inside the Reasoning Loop · Implementation Patterns · Guardrails & Trajectory Evaluation · Persistent External Scratchpad ( Read → Refine → Repeat ) & Salience Decay · GraphRAG (Property Graphs & Community Summaries) · Structured Data (Text-to-SQL)
- **Sample Self-Assessment Questions**:
  - Q1. Why should live order status, inventory counts, or account balances never be served from a RAG vector index?
  - Q2. Why can't raw BM25 and dense cosine similarity scores be added together directly, and how does Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) solve this?
  - Q3. Why is post-filtering unacceptable for enforcing document ACLs or excluding superseded revisions ( is_latest = true )?
  - Q4. Input guardrails inspect the user's prompt before search. Why does that leave an enterprise RAG or agent workflow vulnerable, and what is the fix?
  - Q5. RAG quality gradually degrades over three months with zero code changes and green latency/error dashboards. Someone blames stale prompt-cache hits. Are they right?
  - Q6. When evaluating a cheaper generator model for migration, overall Faithfulness is 0.86 (vs. 0.94 flagship), but two complex legal document classes score 0.72 against a 0.85 per-stratum floor. What should the architect do?

## [Agent Development Kit (ADK)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ADK.html)
- **Canonical URL**: https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ADK.html
- **Summary**: Master Google Agent Development Kit (ADK): LlmAgent, Runner, SessionService, ADK 2.0 graph Workflows, AgentTool, MCP & A2A, Skills, callbacks, guardrails, sandboxing, evaluation, and Agent Runtime deployment.
- **Core Sections**:
  - Overview & Core Mechanics
  - When to Use ADK (vs. a Single Call, a Workflow or Another Framework)
  - Runtime Architecture: Agent, Runner and SessionService
  - Agent Types and Deterministic Control Flow
  - Multi-Agent Delegation: Transfer, AgentTool and Remote Agents
  - Graph Workflows (ADK 2.0), Planners and Custom Agents
  - State, Sessions and Memory
  - Tools and Structured Output
  - MCP and A2A Integration
  - Skills and Progressive Disclosure
  - Callbacks, Plugins and Guardrails
  - Human-in-the-Loop, Resilience and Durability
  - Context Engineering and Performance
  - Security and Sandboxing
  - Evaluation and Observability
  - Deployment, Live Streaming and Developer Tooling
  - Failure Modes and Exam Traps
  - Multimedia & Deep Dive Resources
- **Key Topics & Subsections**: Rule 0 & Agent Theater Litmus Test · SDK vs. ADK · Agent, BaseLlm, Runner, SessionService, MemoryService, ArtifactService, App · Context Objects & Event Ledger · LlmAgent, SequentialAgent, ParallelAgent, LoopAgent, Custom BaseAgent · InstructionProvider & Silent LoopAgent Exit · sub_agents Transfer vs. AgentTool vs. RemoteA2aAgent · Single-Parent Rule & ADK 2.0 Sub-Agent Modes (chat, task, single_turn) · ADK 2.0 Workflow Graph, Event(route=...), JoinNode, RequestInput · BuiltInPlanner & PlanReActPlanner · State Key Scopes (session, user:, app:, temp:) · VertexAiMemoryBankService vs. VertexAiRagMemoryService vs. Document Grounding · FunctionTool, Gemini Built-In Tool Constraints & output_schema · McpToolset, Managed GCP MCP & A2A · SkillToolset 3-Tier Progressive Disclosure · 8 Callback Hooks, BasePlugin Order & Tool-Boundary PII Scrubbing · Tool Confirmation, LongRunningFunctionTool, ResumabilityConfig & 3-Layer Recovery Ladder (HttpRetryOptions, ReflectAndRetryToolPlugin, on_model_error_callback) · static_instruction vs. instruction, include_contents='none', EventsCompactionConfig, ContextCacheConfig · Code Executors (BuiltIn, AgentEngineSandbox, GkeCodeExecutor gVisor sandbox) & Agent Identity · adk eval, adk conformance test, Trajectory Match Types & Informational Efficiency Metrics · Agent Runtime, Cloud Run Ambient Agents & runner.run_live() Bidirectional Audio/Video Streaming
- **Sample Self-Assessment Questions**:
  - Q1. Why does storing conversation state on an Agent instance cause cross-user data leaks under concurrent traffic, and how does ADK solve this?
  - Q2. What happens when a LoopAgent(max_iterations=3) reaches its iteration ceiling without any tool setting escalate = True, and how do you prevent an unapproved draft from reaching the next step in an outer SequentialAgent?
  - Q3. When delegating to a specialist, how does sub_agents=[specialist] differ from wrapping the specialist in AgentTool(agent=specialist)?
  - Q4. Why is scrubbing PII only inside after_model_callback insufficient when an agent queries external customer APIs or support tickets?
  - Q5. An agent uses ReflectAndRetryToolPlugin(max_retries=3) and returns {"status": "error", "error_message": "..."} dictionaries from its tools, yet the plugin never triggers a retry. Why?
  - Q6. Why does returning on the first if event.is_final_response(): inside a runner.run_async(...) loop return an incomplete answer in a multi-agent pipeline?

## [Agentic Design Patterns (ADP)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ADP.html)
- **Canonical URL**: https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/ADP.html
- **Summary**: Vendor-neutral architectural blueprint for enterprise agentic systems: 4-Decision Architectural Order, 3-Bucket Work Decomposition (Deterministic Code vs. Probabilistic LLM vs. Human Review), 5-Factor Work-Shape Matrix, the 5 Canonical Workflows, Autonomous Agent Primitives, 4-Tier CoALA Memory, and Multi-Agent Topologies with typed HandoffContracts.
- **Core Sections**:
  - Overview: Orchestration vs. Autonomy
  - Architectural Triage & Task Decomposition
  - The 5-Factor Work-Shape Pattern Matrix
  - The 5 Canonical Workflow Patterns
  - Autonomous Agent Primitives
  - Memory Architecture & Context Budget
  - Multi-Agent Topologies & Handoffs
  - Anti-Patterns, Failure Modes & Pre-Launch Checklist
  - Self-Assessment Scenarios & Reference Glossary
- **Sample Self-Assessment Questions**:
  - Q1. Why should exact fee calculations and RBAC checks never be delegated to an LLM prompt?
  - Q2. How do Parallelization (Sectioning) and Orchestrator-Workers differ when decomposing subtasks?
  - Q3. Why must an Evaluator-Optimizer critic run in a fresh cold context rather than sharing the generator's conversation history?
  - Q4. Why should subagents receive scoped task inputs and return a typed HandoffContract instead of sharing the coordinator's full message history?

## [AI Evals, Observability & FinOps](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/AIEvalsAndOps.html)
- **Canonical URL**: https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/AIEvalsAndOps.html
- **Summary**: Production engineering for probabilistic AI systems: 3-Tier Grading Hierarchy (Deterministic Code → Calibrated LLM-as-Judge → Human Calibration), `pass@k` vs. `pass^k`, 4-Level Agent Test Pyramid & integration seams, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing & drift detection, 4-Layer Resilience Stack, Shadow Mode vs. 4-Element A/B Testing, heavy-tail sizing, ~15× multi-agent multiplier, and 4-Step Enterprise ROI math.
- **Core Sections**:
  - Evaluation Strategy & The 3-Tier Grading Hierarchy
  - Non-Deterministic Metrics: pass@k vs. pass^k
  - The 4-Level Agent Test Pyramid & Integration Seams
  - Observability, Distributed Tracing & Drift Detection
  - Production Resilience Stack & Fault Isolation
  - Safe Rollouts: Shadow Mode vs. 4-Element A/B Testing
  - Token Economics, Heavy-Tail Sizing & 4-Step Enterprise ROI
  - Production Failure Modes, Glossary & Self-Assessment
- **Sample Self-Assessment Questions**:
  - Q1. Why does a workflow with 90% single-turn accuracy succeed only ~59% of the time on pass^5, and when is pass^k required over pass@k?
  - Q2. How can every prompt component score >95% in isolation while end-to-end production runs fail at 62%?
  - Q3. What four biases affect LLM-as-Judge graders, and how do you mitigate them and validate calibration?
  - Q4. What four steps make up an honest enterprise AI ROI calculation, and why does omitting the human-review tax invalidate the business case?

## [AI Guardrails, Safety & Enterprise Governance](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/AIGovernance.html)
- **Canonical URL**: https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/AIGovernance.html
- **Summary**: Defense-in-depth safety, oversight, fairness, privacy, and governance lifecycle: Trained Alignment vs. App Guardrails, 4-Tier Trust Hierarchy & Lethal Trifecta defense, 3×2 Guardrail Matrix (fail-closed), Stakes-Based HITL Routing (Automation Bias & Consent Fatigue), 4D AI Fluency & Verification Checklist, 4 Fairness Injection Points & Subgroup Disaggregation, 3 Transparency Audiences, ZDR vs. No-Training & HIPAA BAA per-feature scoping, and Enterprise Governance (4 Discovery Categories, Reversal-Cost Tradeoffs, ADRs, Evidenced Control Register).
- **Core Sections**:
  - Trained Alignment vs. Application-Layer Guardrails
  - The 3×2 Defense-in-Depth Guardrail Matrix
  - Stakes-Based Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Architecture
  - The 4D AI Fluency & Output Verification Framework
  - Algorithmic Fairness, Bias Injection Points & Subgroup Auditing
  - Multi-Audience Transparency & Explainability
  - Data Boundaries, Privacy & Regulatory Compliance
  - Enterprise Governance Lifecycle: Scoping, Tradeoffs, ADRs & Control Registers
- **Sample Self-Assessment Questions**:
  - Q1. Why is routing human review solely by model confidence scores dangerous for irreversible tool calls?
  - Q2. How do you run a model-based input guardrail in parallel with main inference without leaking unsafe tokens or executing unverified tools?
  - Q3. How does Zero Data Retention (ZDR) differ from a standard commercial no-training guarantee, and why do stateful features like the Files API require per-feature BAA/ZDR scoping?
  - Q4. What four elements must every architectural tradeoff statement include, and why is an ADR incomplete without rejected alternatives?

  - What is Swarm Prototyping?
  - Multi-Agent Architecture
  - Vibe Coding vs Swarm Prototyping

- **Key Topics & Subsections**: Core Principles of Vibe Coding · Full Autopilot · Collaborative Mode · Human-Led + AI Assist · Key Characteristics of Swarm Prototyping · When to Use Swarm Prototyping · When NOT to Use It · Swarm Patterns · Vibe Coding Tools · Swarm / Multi-Agent Frameworks · Risks & Anti-Patterns · Best Practices · Production Readiness Checklist · Key Takeaways

## [Instruction-Driven Development (IDD / SDD)](https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/idd.html)
- **Canonical URL**: https://mbettan.github.io/machine-learning-cert/idd.html
- **Summary**: Master Instruction-Driven Development (IDD) and Specification-Driven Development (SDD): reproducible AI coding workflows using living markdown specifications.
- **Core Sections**:
  - The Problem with Ad-Hoc Prompting
  - What is IDD / SDD?
  - The IDD Workflow (Step-by-Step)
  - Instruction Documents (Spec Anatomy)
  - IDD vs Vibe Coding vs Traditional
  - Real-World IDD Patterns
  - Tools, Templates & Ecosystem
  - Key Takeaways & Self-Assessment
- **Key Topics & Subsections**: Inconsistency · Context Loss · No Collaboration · Core Philosophy of IDD · Detailed Phase Breakdown · Pattern: Layered Specs · Pattern: Spec-Test-Code Loop · Pattern: Spec as PR Template · Pattern: Instruction Library · Tools That Support IDD Workflows · Spec Storage Best Practices · Spec Quality Checklist · Key Takeaways
- **Sample Self-Assessment Questions**:
  - Q1. What are the three main problems with ad-hoc AI prompting that IDD solves?
  - Q2. Name the 6 sections that make up a well-structured IDD instruction document.
  - Q3. Explain the "Spec-Test-Code Loop" pattern and why it's effective.
  - Q4. How does IDD relate to Vibe Coding? Are they opposites?
  - Q5. What is the "golden rule" of IDD, and what does it mean practically?
  - Q6. Name three tools that provide native support for IDD-style persistent instructions.
